2421-the-beggar-s-opera.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. _Through all the Employments of Life_  _Each Neighbour abuses his Brother_;  _Whore and Rogue they call Husband and Wife_:  _All Professions be-rogue one another_:  _The Priest calls the Lawyer a Cheat_,  _The Lawyer be-knaves the Divine_:  _And the Statesman_, _because he’s so great_,  _Thinks his Trade as honest as mine_.

arxiv-1811-10237.title: Interpreting BEC in e + e - annihilation Talk given at XLVIII International Symposium on Multiparticle Dynamics, Singapore, 3–7 Sep. 2018
arxiv-1811-10237.creator: \firstname W.J. \lastname Metzger \fnsep, \firstname T. \lastname Csörgő, \firstname T. \lastname Novák, \firstname S. \lastname Lökös
arxiv-1811-10237.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by \firstname W.J. \lastname Metzger \fnsep, \firstname T. \lastname Csörgő, \firstname T. \lastname Novák, \firstname S. \lastname Lökös. The usual interpretation of Bose-Einstein correlations (BEC) of identical boson pairs relates the width of the peak in the correlation function at small relative four-momentum to the spatial extent of the source of the bosons. However, in the τ \tau -model, which successfully describes BEC in hadronic Z \mathrm{Z} decay, the width of the peak is related to the temporal extent of boson emission.

arxiv-2009-13241.title: Mixing and observation for Markov operator cocycles
arxiv-2009-13241.creator: Fumihiko NAKAMURA, Yushi NAKANO, Hisayoshi TOYOKAWA
arxiv-2009-13241.description: Abstract . We consider generalized definitions of mixing and exactness for random dynamical systems in terms of Markov operator cocycles. We first give six fundamental definitions of mixing for Markov operator cocycles in view of observations of the randomness in environments, and reduce them into two different groups.

arxiv-2110-09065.title: Investigation of Electronic Structure and Electrochemical Properties of Na 2 MnSiO 4 as a Cathode Material for Na-ion Batteries
arxiv-2110-09065.creator: Vishnu Sudarsanan, Anu Maria Augustine, P Ravindran
arxiv-2110-09065.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Vishnu Sudarsanan, Anu Maria Augustine, P Ravindran. The polyanionic compound Na 2 MnSiO 4 is regarded as one of the promising cathode materials for Na-ion batteries due to good specific capacity with its attractive prospect of utilization of two electrons in the redox processes. So, in this study, we have performed the thermodynamic and electronic structure analysis of Na 2 MnSiO 4 using first principles density functional theory calculations.

arxiv-2110-11222.title: Is High Variance Unavoidable in RL? A Case Study in Continuous Control
arxiv-2110-11222.creator: Johan Bjorck, Carla P. Gomes, Kilian Q. Weinberger
arxiv-2110-11222.description: Abstract Reinforcement learning (RL) experiments have notoriously high variance, and minor details can have disproportionately large effects on measured outcomes. This is problematic for creating reproducible research and also serves as an obstacle when applying RL to sensitive real-world applications. In this paper, we investigate causes for this perceived instability.

arxiv-2211-09117.title: MAGE: MAsked Generative Encoder to Unify Representation Learning and Image Synthesis
arxiv-2211-09117.creator: Tianhong Li, Huiwen Chang, Shlok Kumar Mishra, Han Zhang, Dina Katabi, Dilip Krishnan
arxiv-2211-09117.description: Abstract Generative modeling and representation learning are two key tasks in computer vision. However, these models are typically trained independently, which ignores the potential for each task to help the other, and leads to training and model maintenance overheads. In this work, we propose MAsked Generative Encoder (MAGE), the first framework to unify SOTA image generation and self-supervised representation learning.

arxiv-2305-17404.title: Parallel Corpus for Indigenous Language Translation: Spanish-Mazatec and Spanish-Mixtec
arxiv-2305-17404.creator: Atnafu Lambebo Tonja, Christian Maldonado-Sifuentes, David Alejandro Mendoza Castillo, Olga Kolesnikova, Noé Castro-Sánchez, Grigori Sidorov, Alexander Gelbukh
arxiv-2305-17404.description: Abstract In this paper, we present a parallel Spanish-Mazatec and Spanish-Mixtec corpus for machine translation (MT) tasks, where Mazatec and Mixtec are two indigenous Mexican languages. We evaluated the usability of the collected corpus using three different approaches: transformer, transfer learning, and fine-tuning pre-trained multilingual MT models.

arxiv-2409-10002.title: weighted versions of Saitoh’s conjecture in fibration cases
arxiv-2409-10002.creator: Qi’an Guan, Gan Li, Zheng Yuan
arxiv-2409-10002.description: Abstract . In this article, we introduce some generalized Hardy spaces on fibrations of planar domains and fibrations of products of planar domains. We consider the kernel functions on these spaces, and we prove some weighted versions of Saitoh’s conjecture in fibration cases. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 32A10, 32A25, 32A35, 30H10 1.

arxiv-2502-06780.title: Breaking Quantum Key Distributions under Quantum Switch-Based Attack
arxiv-2502-06780.creator: Sumit Nandi, Biswaranjan panda, Pankaj Agrawal, Arun Kumar Pati
arxiv-2502-06780.description: Abstract Quantum key distribution (QKD) enables secure key sharing between distant parties, with several protocols proven resilient against conventional eavesdropping strategies. Here, we introduce a new attack scenario where an eavesdropper, Eve, exploits a quantum switch using the indefinite causal order to intercept and manipulate quantum communication channel.

arxiv-2502-11850.title: Steering the LoCoMotif: Using Domain Knowledge in Time Series Motif Discovery
arxiv-2502-11850.creator: Aras Yurtman, Daan Van Wesenbeeck, Wannes Meert, Hendrik Blockeel
arxiv-2502-11850.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Aras Yurtman, Daan Van Wesenbeeck, Wannes Meert, Hendrik Blockeel. Time Series Motif Discovery (TSMD) identifies repeating patterns in time series data, but its unsupervised nature might result in motifs that are not interesting to the user. To address this, we propose a framework that allows the user to impose constraints on the motifs to be discovered, where constraints can easily be defined according to the properties of the desired motifs in the application domain.

arxiv-2508-06254.title: From Cognitive Relief to Affective Engagement: An Empirical Comparison of AI Chatbots and Instructional Scaffolding in Physics Education
arxiv-2508-06254.description: Abstract Providing effective, personalized support is critical for helping students overcome conceptual difficulties in physics. However, established scaffolding methods, such as structured tiered support, are often too resource-intensive for widespread implementation. Therefore, this study, investigates whether an easily adaptable, custom-configured AI chatbot can offer comparable affective benefits and cognitive relief.

arxiv-2512-17828.title: Regge trajectories for UV completions of graviton scattering from polynomial boundedness
arxiv-2512-17828.creator: Christopher Eckner, Felipe Figueroa, Simon Metayer, Piotr Tourkine
arxiv-2512-17828.description: Abstract We study graviton scattering amplitudes. Assuming they are UV completed by a theory of weakly coupled massive higher spins, we demonstrate that the UV completion must possess infinitely many Regge trajectories, and thus they are forced to have a stringy spectrum.

britannica-1911-plimer-andrew.description: Article 'Plimer, Andrew' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 21), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. painter, was the son of a clock-maker at Wellington. Disliking his father’s business, he and his brother Nathaniel joined a party of gypsies and wandered about with them, eventually reaching London, where he presented himself to Mrs Cosway in 1781 and was engaged by her as studio boy.

europmc-pmc7237683.title: Allele-aware chromosome-level genome assembly and efficient transgene-free genome editing for the autotetraploid cultivated alfalfa.
europmc-pmc7237683.creator: Chen H, Zeng Y, Yang Y, Huang L, Tang B, Zhang H, Hao F, Liu W, Li Y, Liu Y, Zhang X, Zhang R, Zhang Y, Li Y, Wang K, He H, Wang Z, Fan G, Yang H, Bao A, Shang Z, Chen J, Wang W, Qiu Q.
europmc-pmc7237683.description: Artificially improving traits of cultivated alfalfa (Medicago sativa L.), one of the most important forage crops, is challenging due to the lack of a reference genome and an efficient genome editing protocol, which mainly result from its autotetraploidy and self-incompatibility.

pmc-10590004.title: Training nurses to facilitate and implement CURA in palliative care institutions: development and evaluation of a blended learning program
pmc-10590004.creator: Malene van Schaik, Charlotte Kröger, Lisa Zuidema, Margreet Stolper, Guy Widdershoven, H Roeline Pasman, Suzanne Metselaar
pmc-10590004.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundHealthcare professionals in palliative care are found to be confronted with moral challenges on a frequent basis. CURA is a low-threshold instrument for dialogical ethical reflection that was developed to deal with these challenges. A previous study identified the need of healthcare professionals to be trained to introduce CURA in their organization, initiate and facilitate reflections with CURA, and contribute to the implementation of CURA.

pmc-11270789.title: Effect of liver abnormalities on mortality in Fontan patients: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11270789.creator: Xiang Liu, Linjiang Han, Ziqin Zhou, Jiazichao Tu, Jianrui Ma, Jimei Chen
pmc-11270789.description: BackgroundFontan-associated liver disease (FALD) is one of the most common complications following Fontan procedure, but the impact of FALD on survival outcomes remains controversial. The aim of this systematic review and meta-analysis was to examine and quantify the influence of liver disease on the survival of Fontan patients.

pmc-11535237.title: Automated and closed clinical-grade manufacturing protocol produces potent NK cells against neuroblastoma cells and AML blasts
pmc-11535237.creator: Farhana Jahan, Leena Penna, Annu Luostarinen, Laurens Veltman, Heidi Hongisto, Kaarina Lähteenmäki, Sabine Müller, Seppo Ylä-Herttuala, Matti Korhonen, Kim Vettenranta, Anita Laitinen, Urpu Salmenniemi, Erja Kerkelä
pmc-11535237.description: Natural killer (NK) cells are a promising allogeneic immunotherapy option due to their natural ability to kill tumor cells, and due to their apparent safety. This study describes the development of a GMP-compliant manufacturing protocol for the local production of functionally potent NK cells tailored for high-risk acute myeloid leukemia (AML) and neuroblastoma (NBL) patients.

pmc-12437622.title: Mentalizing and suicide reattempt: a 12-months follow-up study
pmc-12437622.creator: J. Andreo-Jover, B. Orgaz Alvarez, E. Suárez-Soto, P. Saiz Martinez, A. González Pinto, M. Ruiz Veguilla, A. Cebria, N. Roberto, M. Diaz Marsa, M. F. Bravo Ortiz, A. Palao-Tarrero, V. Perez-Sola
pmc-12437622.description: IntroductionHypomentalizing may contribute to heightened social withdrawal and it has been related with an increased risk of and suicide attempt (SA). Although certain studies have identified a relationship between hypomentalizing and suicidal behavior, research on follow-up remains limited.ObjectivesThis study aims to examine the relationship between suicide reattempt and the progression of mentalizing within 12-months.

pmc-12450948.title: Field-deployable lightweight YOLOv8n for real-time detection and counting of Maize seedlings using UAV RGB imagery
pmc-12450948.creator: Pengbo Feng, Zhigang Nie, Guang Li
pmc-12450948.description: The aim of this study is to propose a lightweight YOLOv8n maize seedling detection algorithm that incorporates multi-scale features to address the problems of large number of model parameters and computation, low real-time performance, and small detection range of the existing maize seedling detection models during plant detection.

pmc-12541097.title: Integrating deep learning and radiomics for preoperative glioma grading using multi-center MRI data
pmc-12541097.creator: Shi Yin, Jianguang Ming, Hui Chen, Ying Sun, Chuanlu Jiang
pmc-12541097.description: Accurate preoperative glioma grading remains a critical challenge in neuro-oncology. This study presents a novel integrated approach combining deep learning architectures with radiomics features derived from multi-parametric MRI to improve preoperative glioma grading accuracy. In this retrospective multi-center study, we analyzed 847 patients with histopathologically confirmed gliomas from 5 tertiary neurosurgical centers.

pmc-12564935.title: Co-Treatment with Ritonavir or Sertraline Enhances Itraconazole Efficacy Against Azole-Resistant Trichophyton indotineae Isolates
pmc-12564935.creator: Anna Günther, Anke Burmester, Mario Fabri, Jörg Tittelbach, Cornelia Wiegand, Hamid Badali
pmc-12564935.description: The treatment of azole-resistant Trichophyton indotineae poses a significant challenge for clinicians worldwide. Resistance mechanisms include amino acid substitutions in the sterol 14-α demethylase gene Erg11B, as well as overexpression of Erg11B. Additionally, efflux mechanisms mediated by fungal transporter proteins contribute to antifungal resistance.

pmc-12606839.title: A novel approach to the prevention and management of cardiovascular diseases: targeting brain–heart axis
pmc-12606839.creator: Zheng Rong, Chenchen Meng, Xinyi Li, Xinyi Li, Yangyang Gu, Yulan Li, Wei Mao
pmc-12606839.description: Epidemiological studies indicate that cardiovascular diseases are the leading cause of death and disability worldwide, imposing a significant socioeconomic burden. Despite continuous medical advancements and new preventive measures offering new prospects for the treatment of cardiovascular diseases, the incidence and mortality rates remain high, presenting a challenging outlook for prevention and treatment.

pmc-12982441.title: Comparative genomic and ecological insights into Salmonella enterica serovar Kumasi ST2302 from the first Asian clinical isolate
pmc-12982441.creator: Shijie Peng, Yan Chen, Taigui Chen, Jun Wang, Peijun Lv, Yanan Wang, Xuebin Xu, Yibin Zhou, Yue Liu
pmc-12982441.description: BackgroundSalmonella enterica subspecies enterica serovar Kumasi (S. Kumasi) is an exceptionally rare non-typhoidal Salmonella (NTS) serovar that has been historically linked to plant- or environment-associated sources and only sporadically isolated from humans. Its genomic characteristics, ecological niche, and pathogenic potential remain poorly defined.MethodsThe clinical isolate (XXB410) underwent antimicrobial susceptibility testing and whole-genome sequencing.

pmc-13323692.title: Determination of glycemic index and load of commercially available non-pigmented and pigmented rice varieties in the Philippines
pmc-13323692.creator: Cecile Leah T. Bayaga, Cecile Klaudine C. Cabigas, Isa-Terese D. Santos, Marietoni B. Pico, Elisa Marie M. Andaya, Rosaly V. Manaois, Riza G. Abilgos-Ramos
pmc-13323692.description: Rice is a key commodity in the Philippines, with the majority of Filipinos considering it their staple food. Concerns have arisen about the potential link between the long-term consumption of carbohydrate-rich foods, particularly those with a high glycemic index (GI), and the development of chronic illnesses such as Type 2 diabetes.

pmc-13382266.title: Whole-brain biodistribution of AAV2, AAV8, and AAV-B10 after unilateral intracerebroventricular injection
pmc-13382266.creator: Dezhuang Ye, Abhinav Kayithi, Jinyun Yuan, Isaac Wang, Tianqi Xu, Marc Boisvert, Marie-Eve Paquet, Hong Chen
pmc-13382266.description: Adeno-associated virus (AAV) vectors represent promising tools for central nervous system (CNS) gene therapy; however, achieving efficient and widespread brain gene distribution while minimizing peripheral off-target exposure remains challenging. This study compares the brain and peripheral biodistribution patterns of three AAV serotypes, AAV2, AAV8, and AAV-B10, following intracerebroventricular (i.c.v.) administration in adult female mice.

pmc-13410332.title: Problematic Smartphone Use and Quality of Life Among Greek Nursing Students: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-13410332.creator: Georgios Manomenidis, Vasiliki Georgousopoulou, Elena Vasileiou, Savvato Karavasileiadou, Nikoletta T. Karavasili, Stefanos Mavroudis, Eman Atef
pmc-13410332.description: Highlights Public health relevance—How does this work relate to a public health issue? Problematic smartphone use is an emerging public health concern among nursing students, with potential effects on well-being, daily functioning, and academic life.This study highlights the need to address digital overuse within health-profession education, particularly as smartphones are increasingly embedded in learning and clinical routines.

pmc-13590924.title: Primary Hyperaldosteronism as a Cause of Resistant Hypertension: A Case Report
pmc-13590924.creator: Wasif Majeed Chaudhry, Shazia N Ibnerasa, Waleed Ahmad, Mohammed Hammad Jaber Amin
pmc-13590924.description: In young patients with resistant hypertension and hypokalemia, primary hyperaldosteronism should be suspected. Biochemical assessment and adrenal imaging could identify surgically curable aldosterone‐producing adenomas, and a normalization of blood pressure, potassium levels, and symptom resolution can be achieved through adrenalectomy.

pmc-13591956.title: Epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG) inhibits African swine fever virus replication by targeting key viral proteins and regulating host lipid metabolism
pmc-13591956.creator: Xinglin He, Hong Li, Ruiqi Yang, Pengfei Li, Guiqian Wang, Hua Cao, Yumei Sun, Mengjia Zhang, Yongtao Li, Kaizhi Shi, Anan Jongkaewwattana, Shengnan Ruan, Wentao Li
pmc-13591956.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). African swine fever (ASF) is a highly pathogenic swine infectious disease caused by African swine fever virus (ASFV), with a mortality rate approaching 100% in domestic pigs and causing severe economic losses to the global pig industry. Despite the recent approval of live-attenuated ASF vaccines in limited regions such as Vietnam, universally safe, globally authorized commercial vaccines and effective antiviral therapeutics remain unavailable, creating an urgent demand for innovative anti-ASFV intervention strategies.
